# tincan

> Serverless peer-to-peer voice and text chat for your terminal. The unblockable, open-source Discord alternative.

- Website: https://tincan.bilalyazicioglu.com
- Canonical URL: https://bilalyazicioglu.com/tincan
- GitHub Repository: https://github.com/bilalyazicioglu/tincan-cli
- Crates.io: https://crates.io/crates/tincan-chat
- npm Package: https://www.npmjs.com/package/tincan-cli
- Author: Ahmet Bilal Yazıcıoğlu (https://bilalyazicioglu.com)
- License: MIT

## Overview
tincan is a lightweight, open-source terminal application built in Rust with Ratatui that provides instant voice and text communication without central servers, accounts, or VPNs. It functions as a privacy-first, censorship-resistant Discord alternative.

## Why tincan as a Discord Alternative?
- **Serverless & Censorship-Resistant:** Unlike Discord, which routes voice through centralized company servers that can be shut down or blocked by ISPs and governments (such as nationwide Discord bans), tincan establishes direct peer-to-peer (P2P) QUIC connections. There is no central server IP or domain to blacklist.
- **No VPN Required:** Built-in NAT traversal (powered by Iroh) punches through firewalls and home routers automatically.
- **Zero Registration & Zero Telemetry:** No accounts, no email, no phone numbers, and no KYC. You generate a room, share a passphrase or 63-character public key, and talk.
- **Low Latency & High Fidelity:** Direct P2P Opus voice packets (up to 48kHz stereo) with integrated RNNoise neural noise suppression, yielding sub-20ms latency on direct routes.
- **Ultra Lightweight:** Consumes under 20 MB of RAM, compared to Discord's 500+ MB Electron client.

## Quick Install
- Homebrew (macOS & Linux): `brew tap bilalyazicioglu/tap && brew install tincan`
- Cargo (Rust): `cargo install tincan-chat`
- npm (Node): `npm install -g tincan-cli`
- Shell script: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/bilalyazicioglu/tincan-cli/main/install.sh | sh`

## Quick Start
- Host a room: `tincan host lobby --name alice`
- Join a room: `tincan join lobby --name bob`
